review.method: 5 read-only review agents + cross-measurement; no taic run/resume, no GPU, no LLM
review.offline_gate: uv run pytest -q -m "not gpu and not llm" = 823 passed, 5 skipped, 133 deselected

evidence_levels.agent: measured by a review agent, spot-checked
evidence_levels.unverified: extrapolated or from a single run; must be reproduced

classification.S0: independent of data volume (fixed cost or logic error): fix now
classification.S1: worsens with scale (O(N) scans, files per run): fix now, validate synthetically
classification.S2: needs more data (rates, distributions, A/B, policy tuning): pilot first
classification.C: looks sparse because nothing writes it / wrong model (writer gap)
classification.D: legacy artifact from the deprecated chat path; cold-archive, do not infer hmz cost

findings.title: _priced omits price_cache_write; second committee inherits deepseek 0.0
evidence: conv2d-feedback recorded $15.219922128, recomputed $20.539063128 (35%)
conv2d-flame recorded $7.87428804, recomputed $10.73508804
current protocol runs (conv2d-feedback, FA-2, conv2d-flame) record hit=miss=out=0 in ledger.json; older hmz runs used add() and kept tokens
findings.fix: Set price_cache_write from cacheWrite/input; re-price history by token counts; write cost_basis.

findings.title: transcript stores prompt/reply bodies, O(n^2)
evidence: zstd ~6% of original
system prompt repeated ~64x (~64MB) while system_prompt.txt holds it once
hmz transcripts are only 10-13KB (agent metadata)
findings.fix: Default to metadata only; bodies behind --keep-agent-io + zstd; sys_sha reference.

findings.title: agent_work is unbounded and copies 5 static files per session
evidence: 112MB / 1409 files; all-run median 40; agent_work-run median 29; current large runs: 797/25 = 31.9 files/session (conv2d-feedback), 558/21 = 26.6 (FA-2), 239/14 = 17.1 (conv2d-flame)
msl_reference 16KB x21, TASK.md 23KB x21, experience 5.4KB x21, seed kernel/report x20 per run
v/ has 296 files and 83.7MB of ablation kernels with no reader
findings.fix: Run hmz in $TMPDIR/taic/<run>/<label>; copy back NOTES/self_checks/submission; tar.zst scratch with 50MB cap.

findings.title: every request path is O(all runs)
evidence: history() loads every row_json: 54KB/14ms at 52 runs
sync_known(): 1093 stat / 14.8ms at 52 runs
tick() on every runs_page and every SSE frame; SSE is per connection at 1Hz
25s/request at 1e5 runs is an extrapolation (U)
findings.fix: Write-through journal; no scan on request path; aggregate tables; shared ticker; keyset paging.

findings.title: candidate-level facts are not indexed
evidence: 741 candidates / 748 candidate reports; 133 abi_error, 84 incorrect, 29 compile_error
no kernel_sha256 column; no FTS5; task/operator/model/dtype/publication unindexed
runs_page is LIMIT/OFFSET only; the missing composite index does not exist yet (the earlier 'status != missing defeats it' wording was one step too far)
findings.fix: candidates table + kernel_sha + partial indexes + FTS5 + keyset + stop_class enum.

findings.title: run_detail recomputes everything; feature_grid is 10.7s
evidence: payload 44.7-259KB; server read 95.5MB to return 187KB (U: not re-measured in review)
feature_grid re-hashes every candidate kernel; 25 kernels = 10.7s cold (U: not re-measured in review)
state/result share 23 keys; timeline/llm/confirmations are unused by the page
findings.fix: Compute feature_grid/kernel_writer at ingest; split summary + lazy tab sub-resources.

findings.title: brief reads the transcript twice and injects global GPU events
evidence: 1039B of GPU lock events from unrelated runs: 39/42/73% of 2693/2454/1416B payloads
260-456B absolute paths; cands capped at 8 and drops cost_usd/improved/within_noise
legacy run: 305-445ms and 149MB read; hmz run is small
findings.fix: Index-backed summary; --gpu opt-in; relative paths; schema_version/stamp; page cands.

findings.title: TASK.md re-sends ~7.2k tokens every session
evidence: init 10,946B; review sample r20.p0 26,616B: peer tips 8,201B + previous NOTES 4,565B
the 12,766B span from the NOTES heading to '# 证据' includes the tips; NOTES alone is 4,565B
tips shrink sometimes (r15 8,068B -> r16 7,947B -> r20 8,201B), so budget them as a capped summary
findings.fix: Constant contract once; NOTES as L1 summary + path; tips as digests; target <=12KB (-53%).

findings.title: batch production is not re-entrant
evidence: an interrupted cell is treated as never-run; Orchestrator refuses a non-empty dir; RunStartError kills the whole suite
resume moves result.json to result.before_topup_N.json, so a second crash looks never-run
_confirm re-measures all batches on every resume; FA-2 winner measured 5x
findings.fix: queue.jsonl with needs_resume; run(cell) resumes; confirm/<sha>.json idempotent; evalkey cache.

findings.title: GPU/LLM waste: candidate_serial, re-timed baselines, unchanged sessions
evidence: candidate_serial is 34% of timed GPU and is read by nothing; baselines are 33% and re-timed per candidate (mlx cv 0.8%)
unchanged 15/25 sessions cost $10.46/$15.22 in ONE run (S2, do not generalise)
findings.fix: Drop candidate_serial by default; pin baselines per (task,target,calibration); eval cache; pilot unchanged_patience.

findings.title: dashboard is a 84KB inline page with full rebuilds and no URL state
evidence: 84KB HTML, no gzip/ETag; initial 3 requests + SSE ~106KB; every revision re-sends 36KB+
main list rebuilds tbody innerHTML; filters not in URL; no sort/FTS/page size
stop_reason not displayed; 6 of 16 columns rendered; no charts; page carries the write token
review page is already incremental by feedback_revision and replaces one card (feedback.py:735-750, index.html:450)
findings.fix: Asset split + gzip/ETag; URL state; keyset + virtual list; aggregates/charts; CSP + one escaper.

findings.title: retention/deletion is a move, not a policy
evidence: data/deleted = 266MB, no TTL/compression; deletion_log.jsonl is inside gitignored data/
kernel catalog overwrites best.metal; history keeps only source_sha256, so confirmed sources are lost
31/31 resume.lock files are stale pids
findings.fix: deleted/ manifest + tar.zst + TTL; audit log outside data/; blobs + refcount for kernels.

findings.title: experiment provenance is missing
evidence: p1 (12 arms, 418MB, $35.34) and repeat_20261007 (163MB) have no experiment.json
observe: experiments=2, arms=0
17/29 run_configs are git_dirty with no diff; no calibration sha or toolchain; only first committee price recorded
findings.fix: Write manifest per experiment; arm deltas in data not code; record prices/calibration/toolchain; backfill.

findings.title: identity and vocabulary are not canonical
evidence: three run_id forms; publication has five values including CJK free text; brief has no schema_version
runs.model is [llm].model; in the 60 current sessions kimi is 28 sessions and ~80% of recorded spend ($28.98/$36.43)
findings.fix: One RunSummary + schema_version; publication enum; per-session committee/model; one run_id.

findings.title: protocol epochs are not recorded, so aggregates mix incompatible measurements
evidence: run_config v1/v2; confirm batches 1->3; encode moved inside the timing window in d3bd2dc; target refactor changed contract/limits
no protocol_version/metric_protocol column
findings.fix: Record protocol_version per run/eval; group aggregates by epoch; backfill legacy=epoch0.

P0: Record per-session committee/model/tokens/cost/cost_basis; split ledger tokens; index the columns.
Slim TASK.md (constant contract once, NOTES L1, tips digests).
Index v5: candidates + kernel_sha + partial indexes + FTS5 + keyset; move sync_known/history/tick off the request path; compute feature_grid/summary at ingest.
Summary-first brief/detail; drop GPU/absolute paths; add schema_version and lazy tabs.
Idempotent batch queue; resume must not move result.json; eval cache; backfill experiment manifests.
Storage hygiene: transcript bodies off by default; agent_work out/capped; blobs + manifest; retention/GC; cold-archive legacy.

pilot.zero_cost: copy/hardlink existing runs to /tmp to synthesise 1e3/1e4 entries and measure index/query latency

P1: Leaderboard, failure, cost, catalog pages from aggregates.
FTS tuning, A/B attribution, charts, exports/snapshots.
patience / unchanged_patience / committee rotation only after the pilot.

known_disagreements.resolution: different denominators; content addressing saves file count/scratch, not total bytes
policy decision; do not compare as if one number
legacy transcript size, not hmz design
lazy by design; first read still full
do not pool chat and hmz epochs
398 is not reproducible; use files/session and name the run

non_goals: Do not run taic run/resume, GPU kernels, or LLM calls without explicit budget approval.
Do not tune patience/unchanged/committee policy on n=2-3 runs.
Do not content-address the whole legacy tree for a 3.5% byte gain.
Do not treat runs.model as the session model.
Do not aggregate speed/cost/confirmed across protocol epochs.
